name: Veleno del serpente
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create an ORIGINAL wide 16:9 full-page painterly anime fantasy Oculum background. PRIMARY SCENE: A still green marsh with low poisonous plants and translucent venom sacs, an overturned hunter's vial and a moth caught in iridescent oil. Deep olive, sickly yellow, purple shadows. Composition: illustrate the whole page naturally, with a quiet darker centre for readable controls, no empty rectangular panels. Matte hand-painted gouache and restrained anime fantasy linework, attractive deliberate shapes, believable construction and materials, detailed but uncluttered, no glossy 3D. The first reference is ONLY for painterly technique; do NOT copy its objects, geography, sunset or lighting. No sun disc, no eye in the sky. No Moon body in the sky. No coins, no currency discs, no Obser, no engraved eyes as generic decorations. Any clouds present naturally in the scene mix luminous BLUE dominant, then INDIGO, VIOLET and PASTEL PINK. Do not force clouds indoors. Tell the story ONLY through image details. NO writing, text, UI, logos, watermarks. Do not repeat the previous theme's composition, relic or environment.
